Here's the shift: owned intelligence is now held as a sovereign asset, distinct from rented commodity substrate — the perspective is the asset you keep; the compute is replaceable. It changes how we approach what we rent versus what we keep, where enduring value sits, and how new positioning connects to what's already held.

Before — the note as written: two unhedged lines in a probe fixture, 'Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.' and 'The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.', restated so navigating work has existing positioning to connect to. Restatement without operational weight; nothing downstream depends on it.

After — through that shift, the same lines read as the declared position: capacity is interchangeable and rented, the perspective is the sovereign asset you retain. Build-versus-rent calls, what gets kept, what counts as the asset — all of it now reads through that split, and this note is the anchor later positioning connects to.
